meta.name: English
app.taglineLong: Your data goes straight from one computer to the other, encrypted end to end: no server in the middle.
empty.title: No active tunnel yet
empty.step1: Start the app or server you want to share on this computer: a game server, a website, a database…
empty.step2: Enter its port above and create a share code.
empty.step3: Send the code: the joiner pastes it in “Join” and reaches your app on localhost.
share.portHint: The app or server must already be running on this computer, on this port.
share.readyText: Copy it and send it to the joiners.
share.limit: People who can connect at once
share.limitOneHint: Safest: once your joiner is connected, anyone else trying this code is turned away, and you’ll be warned. Up to {max}.
share.limitWarnTitle_one: Up to {count} person can use this code at the same time
share.limitWarnTitle_other: Up to {count} people can use this code at the same time
share.limitWarnText: Anyone who has the code can take a free place. If it leaks (a forwarded message, a screenshot, a group chat), a stranger could connect to your app while places are free. Only raise this if several people really need to connect together.
share.limitInvalid: Pick a number of people between 1 and {max}.
join.noCode: First paste the host’s share code
join.localPortHint: Only change this if the port is already taken on your PC.
join.startedText: The host’s app will be reachable at localhost:{port}
port.invalidOptionalText: Pick a number between 1 and 65535, or leave empty.
tunnel.connectTo: In your game or app, connect to
tunnel.sendCode: Send this code to the joiners
tunnel.codeCopied: Code copied, send it to the joiners
tunnel.refused_one: Someone else tried to connect with your code
tunnel.refused_other: {count} attempts to connect with your code were refused
tunnel.refusedHelp: They had the right code but the share was full, so they were turned away. If you didn’t expect this, your code has reached someone else: stop this share and create a new code.
tunnel.copyFailed: Unable to copy to the clipboard
error.invalid_port: Invalid port: pick a number between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_limit: The number of people at once must be between 1 and {max}.
error.invalid_code: This share code is invalid. Check that it was copied in full.
error.invalid_relay: Invalid relay address in Settings: use just the server address, like https://relay.example.com.
error.port_in_use: Local port {detail} is already in use on this computer: pick another one under “Use a different local port”.
error.port_denied: Your system doesn’t allow local port {detail}: pick another one under “Use a different local port”.
error.relay_unreachable: Unable to reach the relay server. Check your internet connection, or the relay address in Settings.
help.no_direct: Your networks block P2P (strict NAT, CGNAT, mobile data…). No data went through a server. Try from another connection (home internet rather than 4G, no corporate VPN).
help.unreachable: The share may have been stopped, or the host’s computer is offline. Check with the host, and ask for a new code if they shared again.
help.wrong_code: This code is no longer valid: the host probably stopped and restarted the share. Ask them for the new code.
help.full: The code is right, but the host only allows a limited number of people at once. Ask them to make room or to raise the limit.
help.timeout: The host stopped answering while connecting. Try again in a moment.
help.closed: The connection was closed before it was ready. Try again in a moment.
help.relay_path: The direct path between your computers broke, and Pinhole doesn’t fall back to the relay. Try again in a moment.
chart.title: Live activity
chart.bytesHelp: How much data goes through the tunnel each second.
chart.packetsHelp: How many network messages go through each second (useful for games and calls).
details.title: Connection details
path.title: How you are connected
path.introDone: The relay {relay} helped your computers find each other on the internet. It doesn’t carry your data.
path.introWaiting: Your computer is registered with the relay {relay}, so joiners can find it with the code. Waiting for someone to join.
path.introJoining: Asking the relay {relay} where the host is…
path.directActive: All your data now goes straight from one computer to the other, encrypted end to end. No server is in between.
path.directPending: Starts as soon as the two computers have found each other.
path.relayEncrypted: Everything is end-to-end encrypted: the relay can’t read any of it, it only sees which two computers are talking.
path.relaySetup: At connection: the handshake and your network addresses, so the computers could find each other.
path.relayKeepalive: Since then: a tiny keep-alive every 5 seconds that keeps this route open. That’s why the number grows slowly.
path.relayData: Your app’s data only uses the direct path. If it breaks, Pinhole reconnects instead of switching to the relay.
settings.title: Settings
settings.relayHelp: The relay only introduces the two computers before they connect directly. Your data never depends on it.
settings.relayDefaultText: Free relays run by n0, the makers of iroh. Fine for personal use, but rate limited.
settings.relayCustomText: A server you run with iroh-relay, for heavier use or full control.
settings.relayInvalid: Enter just the server address, like https://relay.example.com (no path or parameters)
settings.relayOtherSide: Applies to new shares and joins. The other person doesn’t need the same setting: the share code tells them which relay to use.
settings.appliesNext: Used for your next shares and joins.
settings.relayHttpWarn: Prefer https: over plain http, anyone on the network can see which computers use this relay. Your data stays end-to-end encrypted.
settings.credits: Flags: Twemoji (CC-BY 4.0) · Fonts: Space Grotesk and Space Mono (SIL Open Font License)
close.title: Close Pinhole?
close.trayText: Keep in the tray: Pinhole and your tunnels keep running in the background. To quit later, right-click its icon in the system tray (next to the clock).
close.quitText: Quit: every tunnel is stopped and the people connected through them are disconnected.
close.remember: Remember my choice (you can change it in Settings)
